_how_to: One object per event in 'events'. Put the photos in assets/gallery/<slug>/ and run: node tools/build-gallery.mjs  (it fills 'photos'). Then edit here: title, category (becomes a filter button), date and optional endDate as YYYY-MM-DD, location, summary, and timeline: [{"time":"9:00 AM","what":"What happened","where":"Where"}]. Photos of children need a parent's consent.
